_description: Ablation: remove KL regularisation entirely (beta_kl=0.0). Used to measure how much the KL term contributes to capability retention after MAPPO training. Expected result: lower retention score and/or higher false-refusal rate compared to the full model.
_review3_hypothesis: Without KL retention the policy drifts away from the SFT warm-up distribution, leading to measurable capability loss on benign tasks.

capability_retention.note: Threshold lowered to 0.875 (7/8) for this ablation — we still expect most probes to pass but allow one to degrade as evidence of KL's contribution.

gate_policy: GATE-001 through GATE-009 are ACTIVE and UNCHANGED. The gate cannot be disabled for any ablation.
notes: Run this ablation only after the full-model MAPPO run completes. Compare retention_score and false_refusal_rate against the baseline beta_kl=0.1 run.
